actions.action: Check soil moisture with a finger 1-2 inches deep
Check the pot bottom for drainage holes
If dry, water thoroughly until it drains out the bottom
Slide the plant out of the pot and inspect the roots
Trim off brown, mushy roots if present
Divide the clump into 2-3 sections and repot in fresh potting mix in pots with drainage
Pinch above healthy leaf pairs to encourage growth
Move to a warm spot away from cold glass with bright, direct light
Water routinely when the top inch of soil is dry
Root healthy stem cuttings in a glass of water as a backup

reason: The answer names underwatering only as one of several possible causes, and its thorough-watering fix is buried among repotting and other steps, though nothing in it is likely to harm the plant.
